title: Aberdeen's Blessing
description: Father Aldwin is the last priest of Chronos left in Aberdeen - the two who served with him died the year the temple was abandoned, and no one has been sent to replace them. He keeps the faith alone now, in a town too poor to rebuild the shrine, which is why the Sacred Hourglass sitting in the ruined inner sanctum matters more to him than its gold would suggest: it is the only working timepiece Aberdeen has left, and every rite he performs without one is a rite measured by guesswork.

objectives.description: Travel to the ruined Temple of Chronos east of Aberdeen
Recover the last working timepiece Aberdeen has left

notes: Threat: named concretely - Aldwin is Aberdeen's last priest of Chronos and the hourglass is his only working timepiece, not generic temple treasure. Giver motive: doctrinal necessity, not sentiment - a rite measured by guesswork offends the same principle chronos_02_hourglasses runs on. Consequence: not wired; Aldwin keeps performing rites by guesswork if the relic is never recovered.
